children: Expand Energy completed an underwritten public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.650% senior notes due 2031. The notes were issued under an Indenture with Regions Bank as trustee, including a supplemental indenture detailing the series terms. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, with optional redemption provisions including a par call on or after August 15, 2031. Proceeds strengthen the company's capital position and financial flexibility.
